reason: The Lasso was fit in memory and only the 2024 and 2023 predictions were written. No pickle, joblib, or coefficient vector exists on disk. Reconstructing the intercept, coefficients, and standardization vectors would require a refit, which this packaging pass does not do.
what_is_saved: predictions/lear.parquet has split, y_true, and y_pred. lear_selection.json records alpha 0.01 and the 2022 penalty grid.
target: asinh(price), predictions clipped to asinh +/- 10 then mapped with sinh
features: asinh of HB_HUBAVG at t-1, t-24, and t-168
asinh of the same-hour day-ahead hub price
hour, day-of-week, and month dummies in US/Central
standardization: StandardScaler fit on the pre-2023 rows used for the final refit. The mean and scale were not written.
